corpora.description: pdf.js regression corpus: ~1000 real-world PDFs (broken xref tables, odd fonts, every image filter, forms, annotations) kept in-repo under test/pdfs. A further 460 entries are .link files pointing at external URLs; those are fetched only with --include-linked.
corpora.license: Apache-2.0 (pdf.js repository license). Individual linked PDFs belong to their original publishers and are not redistributable.
corpora.approximateSize: archive 106 MB; 989 PDFs, 119 MB on disk; .link targets add several hundred MB
corpora.notes: Pinned to master on 2026-10-09. Many .link targets are web.archive.org snapshots and some are dead; link failures are reported, not fatal.

corpora.description: PDF Association PDF 2.0 example files: UTF-8 strings, black point compensation, page-level output intents, incremental update to 2.0, non-zero file start offset.

veraPDF test corpus: atomic pass/fail files for PDF/A-1a..4f and PDF/UA-1/2, plus ISO 32000-1/-2 edge cases, the Isartor PDF/A-1 suite and the TWG test files. Each file documents its purpose in its outline.
corpora.license: CC BY 4.0 (README.md in the repository). The embedded Isartor files remain subject to the PDF Association Isartor terms of use (see the isartor entry).
corpora.approximateSize: archive 149 MB; 2906 PDFs, 160 MB on disk
corpora.notes: Pinned to the default branch (staging) on 2026-10-09. Folder names carry spaces (e.g. 'Isartor test files/'); keep them, the names encode the clause under test.

corpora.description: Apache PDFBox test resources from the pdfbox module: PDFBOX-NNNN regression PDFs, expected text extractions, fonts, images and signing keystores.
corpora.license: Apache-2.0 (Apache PDFBox LICENSE and NOTICE). Some regression files originate from JIRA reporters; see NOTICE.txt in the repository.
corpora.approximateSize: archive 22 MB; 303 files (137 PDFs), 14 MB on disk
corpora.notes: Pinned to trunk on 2026-10-09. Only pdfbox/src/test/resources is kept; the many JIRA attachments PDFBox tests download at test time are not included.

corpora.description: Ghent Workgroup PDF Output Suite 5.0: 48 numbered PDF/X-4 patches plus a six-page test document for print-production rendering (overprint, transparency, ICC-based color, spot colors).
corpora.license: Copyright Ghent Workgroup. Free to download and use for testing; redistribution of the files requires permission from admin@gwg.org (https://gwg.org/terms-of-service/). Do not commit or package these files.
corpora.notes: Direct download, no form required as of 2026-10-09. Extracted as-is, including the GWG documentation PDFs.

corpora.description: DARPA SafeDocs / Digital Corpora CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED: ~7.9 million untruncated PDFs re-fetched from the Common Crawl July/August 2021 crawl, packaged 1000 per zip (7,933 zips of 1.0-2.8 GB each) under zipfiles/NNNN-NNNN/NNNN.zip.
corpora.license: Common Crawl terms of use (https://commoncrawl.org/terms-of-use) apply to the PDFs; Digital Corpora's own metadata is CC0 (https://digitalcorpora.org/about-digitalcorpora/terms-of-use/). Files are third-party web content: use for testing only.
corpora.approximateSize: ~8 TB total; a single zip such as zipfiles/0000-0999/0000.zip is 1.27 GB
corpora.notes: Never downloaded by this tool. For a sample, download one zip by hand (or via s3://digitalcorpora/corpora/files/CC-MAIN-2021-31-PDF-UNTRUNCATED/) into corpus/safedocs/ and extract it there. Treat the files as hostile input.

corpora.description: PDFium test corpus (pdfium_tests repository, checked out at testing/corpus in PDFium builds): thousands of small PDFs covering rendering, forms, JavaScript, XFA and fuzzer-found crashes, with expected PNGs omitted here.
corpora.license: BSD-3-Clause (LICENSE in the repository, 'PDFium Authors'). The third_party/ subtree contains files under their own licenses; check before redistributing.
corpora.approximateSize: archive 318 MB tar.gz (includes expected PNGs); PDFs only on disk
corpora.notes: Ref is pdfium_tests_revision from PDFium main DEPS on 2026-10-09. Gitiles archives have no top-level folder, hence stripPrefix 0. Note the task's https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/testing/corpus path no longer exists; the corpus is the separate pdfium_tests repository.

corpora.description: qpdf test suite PDFs (qpdf/qtest/qpdf): hand-crafted files for object streams, cross-reference streams, encryption (RC4/AES, all revisions), linearization, damaged files and recovery.
corpora.license: Apache-2.0 (qpdf 7.0+; see LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.md in the repository).
corpora.approximateSize: archive 21 MB; 628 PDFs, ~35 MB on disk
corpora.notes: Pinned to main on 2026-10-09. Expected outputs (.out, .check) are not kept.

corpora.description: BFO PDF/A-2 test suite: pass and fail files named after the ISO 19005-2 clause they exercise, in the Isartor layout.
corpora.license: No license file in the repository; published by BFO (bfo.com) as a community test suite with contributions invited. Use for conformance testing; ask support@bfo.com before redistributing.

corpora.description: PDF Association Isartor test suite: 204 PDF/A-1b files, each violating exactly one clause of ISO 19005-1.
corpora.license: PDF Association Isartor terms of use: free to use for checking PDF validation software and for publishing conformance declarations; all other rights reserved; not for third-party certification.
corpora.notes: pdfa.org answers automated requests with HTTP 403 and the download sits behind a terms-of-use acceptance page, so this entry is manual. The same files are already fetched as part of verapdf-corpus under 'Isartor test files/'.
